description: This file contains a class HeliconeLogger responsible for logging events to Helicone, including mapping responses from different models, adding metadata from headers, and managing log submission via HTTP POST requests. It specifically supports models like 'gpt', 'claude', and others, and includes functions for logging success events and processing metadata.

classes.name: HeliconeLogger
classes.description: A class for logging events and responses to Helicone, supporting response mapping, metadata handling, and HTTP logging.

methods.name: dict add_metadata_from_header(litellm_params: dict, metadata: dict)
methods.description: Adds metadata from proxy request headers, filtering for keys starting with 'helicone_', and removes internal tracing span.

methods.description: Logs a successful response event to Helicone, including preparing request data, handling model-specific adjustments, and posting the data via HTTP.
